objective: Implement local project and task CRUD application flows on top of the existing foundation, including project create/edit/archive/browse and task create/edit/filter flows with provisional support and deterministic dedup keys.
success_criteria: Project CRUD application flows exist for create, edit, archive, list, and detail retrieval using local repositories.
Task CRUD application flows exist for create, edit, archive, detail retrieval, and local list filtering.
Task provisional behavior and needs-review flags are preserved through the application service.
Task dedup keys are computed consistently from normalized task data before finalized writes.
The implementation remains local-only and uses the existing repository and audit foundations.
stop_conditions: The task requires introducing platform UI, routing, or app-shell code.
The task requires schema changes outside the current migration set.
The task requires remote services, sync, or hosted persistence.
approval_gates: Expanding scope into UI shell or platform integration
Changing database schema instead of implementing application flows on the current foundation
notes: Ticket sources: docs/implementation-tickets.md T4 and T5.
Keep the implementation at the application-flow level; future screens should be able to call these services directly.
